original_card.question: Can a changed G20 helper path or independent-target split improve the complete BIT moment without losing its physical endpoint?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: First read #5679/#5708 and their audits as pending component proposals. Choose one uncovered helper group/cut on an exact word; compare arbitrary-input native action, targets, owned storage, both orientations and full signed bill. Stop if the gain is only a scalar count or repaid by lost targets. Do not rerun the frozen #5609 common-frame domain without changing its hypothesis.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.
scope_change_triggers: Changing source head, helper/cut domain, operation alphabet or caller boundary without recording the new scope.
Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

existing_checks.scope: Selected PR5599: complete helper-subspace construction and independent caller replay; five framework assumptions remain.
existing_checks.remaining: The next experiment must identify uncovered source-specific work. Successor archive intake does not transfer this admission.

actual_scope: On the emitted PR5708 word and its one-edge route table, move exactly two corrections of each 2-, 3- or 4-contact A2 conjugation onto non-contact frames, keep the other corrections on their contact frames, and decide whether any rewritten word emits and lowers the paid-query moment on (0,1).
scope_change_reason: PR6337 moved one correction at 1..3 contacts, PR6633 moved one correction at 4 contacts, and PR6305 kept every correction on its contact frame at 4+ contacts. Both moved-frame packages leave the two-move case open (PR6633 open question 1). This package takes that clause on the same word, route table and constructor.
bottleneck_link: A paid-moment obstruction on this exact word says the short two-move conjugation domain does not raise the ordinary BIT component. It does not change the selected exponent.
stop_rule: Stop when every two-move assignment on the 700 intervals is classified. Do not add a route, move three or more corrections, or move a frame at five or more contacts.
evidence: python3 -I -B research/g20-two-moved-corrections/verify.py prints PASS_G20_TWO_MOVED_CORRECTIONS with assignments=723788875, emitted=0 and savings=0.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Can three or more moved corrections in one 3- or 4-contact interval emit and lower the paid moment?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This census moves exactly two corrections. Only 99 two-move words survive to a full replay, and each misses a later route, so a third move would have to repair that later route.
open_questions.first_step: For the 99 tail-missing two-move words, name the first missing route and test whether moving a later correction of the same interval can supply it.
open_questions.blocked_by: No two-move word emits, so no seed is supplied.

open_questions.question: Can one or two moved corrections at five or more contacts lower the paid moment?
open_questions.why_it_matters: PR6305 covers five or more contacts only at the contact frame; the moved-frame screens stop at four contacts.
open_questions.first_step: Run the same prefix-resumed census on the 5-contact intervals with one moved frame.

open_questions.question: Does a single added route make any two-move word emit with a saving?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Every rejection here is a missing edge of the published table, not a proof that another native path is impossible.
open_questions.first_step: Group the 255,171 second-meeting failures and 99 tail failures by first missing ordered frame pair and price the most frequent pair.
open_questions.blocked_by: Adding a route changes the contract and needs its own native cost.
